ei.title: The Life and Achievements of Bessie Smith, the Empress of the Blues

fullPassage: Bessie Smith was born in Chattanooga, Tennessee in 1894. She had a poor and unnoticed childhood. Her father died shortly after Bessie was born, and her mother died by the time she was eight or nine. Bessie was reared by her oldest sister Viola. As a consequence, Bessie was unable to gain an education. Around 1913 she toured in a show with Ma Rainey, one of the first great blues singers. Bessie's big break came in 1923, when she made her first recordings, including the classic Down Hearted Blues, which became an enormous success, selling more than two million copies. She recorded approximately 160 songs, accompanied by musicians who also made music history, including trumpet player Louis Armstrong. Bessie died in 1937 and is still remembered today as the "Empress of the Blues."

questions.passage: Bessie Smith was born in Chattanooga, Tennessee in 1894. She had a (A)[poor / wealthy] and unnoticed childhood. Her father died shortly after Bessie was born, and her mother died by the time she was eight or nine. Bessie was reared by her oldest sister Viola. As a consequence, Bessie was (B)[unable / eager] to gain an education. Around 1913 she toured in a show with Ma Rainey, one of the first great blues singers. Bessie's big break came in 1923, when she made her first recordings, including the classic Down Hearted Blues, which became an enormous success, selling more than two million copies. She recorded approximately 160 songs, accompanied by musicians who also made music history, including trumpet player Louis Armstrong. Bessie died in 1937 and is still (C)[remembered / forgotten] today as the "Empress of the Blues."
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① poor - unable - remembered: 어린 시절은 '가난했고', 교육을 '받을 수 없었으며', 오늘날 '기억되고' 있다는 원문 내용.
❌ ② wealthy - unable - remembered: '부유했다'는 가난하고 교육도 못 받았다는 이후 흐름과 모순.
❌ ③ poor - eager - remembered: '갈망했다'는 As a consequence(그 결과) 교육을 못 받았다는 인과 논리와 반대.
❌ ④ poor - unable - forgotten: '잊혀졌다'는 오늘날에도 Empress of the Blues로 기억된다는 원문과 정반대.
det.tip: poor(가난한) ↔ wealthy(부유한). unable to(~할 수 없는) ↔ eager to(~하기를 갈망하는). remember(기억하다) ↔ forget(잊다)

det.analysis:
✅ ① reared - toured - success: 언니에 의해 '길러졌고', Ma Rainey와 함께 '순회공연 했으며', 그 노래가 큰 '성공'을 거두었다는 원문.

det.analysis:
✅ ③ including - approximately - accompanied: Down Hearted Blues를 '포함한' 첫 녹음, '대략' 160곡, 음악가들에 의해 '반주된(함께 한)' 것이 원문.

questions.stem: 밑줄 없이 제시된 (A)와 (B)의 break의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ (A) 기회 - (B) 휴식: (A)의 big break는 '큰 기회(전환점)'이라는 관용 표현. (B)는 수업 사이의 짧은 '휴식' 시간.
❌ ① (A) 휴식 - (B) 기회: (A)에서 첫 녹음은 휴식이 아니라 결정적 기회. (B)에서 물 마시는 시간은 기회가 아님.
❌ ② (A) 파괴 - (B) 휴식: (A)에서 '파괴'는 big break 관용구 해석과 맞지 않음.
❌ ④ (A) 기회 - (B) 파괴: (B)에서 수업 사이의 '파괴'는 부자연스러움.
det.tip: break 다의어: 1. (big break) 큰 기회, 전환점. 2. (take a break) 휴식. 3. 부수다, 고장나다.

다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?
"To travel from place to place, especially to perform shows or concerts."

det.analysis:
✅ ② tour: '공연이나 콘서트를 위해 여러 장소를 돌아다니다' = 순회공연 하다.
❌ ① record: '녹음하다'는 한 장소에서 하는 활동.
❌ ③ gain: '얻다'는 이동 개념이 없음.
❌ ④ forget: '잊다'는 공연과 무관.
det.tip: tour(순회공연 하다) - 여러 도시를 돌며 공연하는 활동. 명사로는 '여행, 순회공연'.

questions.passage: Bessie Smith made her first recordings in 1923. Her __________ (record) of Down Hearted Blues sold more than two million copies.
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) (   ) 쓰시오.

det.analysis: record(동사: 녹음하다) -> recording(명사: 녹음). 'Her recording of ~'는 '~의 녹음본'이라는 명사 표현.
det.tip: record(녹음하다, 동사) -> recording(녹음, 명사). -ing가 붙어 동명사 혹은 명사형으로 사용.

questions.passage: Bessie Smith was a great singer. Her __________ (achieve) in the blues music world made her the "Empress of the Blues."
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) (   ) 쓰시오.

det.analysis: achieve(동사: 달성하다) -> achievement(명사: 업적) -> achievements(복수). 'Her achievements'는 소유격 + 복수 명사.
det.tip: achieve(달성하다) -> achievement(업적) -> achievements(업적들). -ment는 대표적 명사형 접미사.

questions.passage: Bessie Smith was born in Chattanooga, Tennessee in 1894. She had a poor and unnoticed childhood. Her father died shortly after Bessie was born, and her mother died by the time she was eight or nine. Bessie was reared by her oldest sister Viola. As a consequence, Bessie was unable to gain an education. Around 1913 she toured in a show with __________. Bessie's big break came in 1923, when she made her first recordings, including the classic Down Hearted Blues, which became an enormous success, selling more than two million copies. She recorded approximately 160 songs, accompanied by musicians who also made music history, including trumpet player Louis Armstrong. Bessie died in 1937 and is still remembered today as the "Empress of the Blues."
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: Ma Rainey, 최초의 위대한 블루스 가수 중 한 명.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ Ma Rainey, one of the first great blues singers: Bessie가 1913년 함께 순회공연한 인물. 원문 그대로.
❌ ① Louis Armstrong, a trumpet player: Armstrong은 이후 녹음에서 반주한 음악가.
❌ ② her oldest sister Viola: Viola는 양육자이지 공연 파트너가 아님.
❌ ③ a group of opera singers: 오페라 가수는 본문에 없으며 Bessie는 블루스 가수.
det.tip: Ma Rainey = Bessie의 초기 멘토 격 블루스 가수. 1913년 함께 투어.

questions.passage: Bessie Smith was born in Chattanooga, Tennessee in 1894. She had a poor and unnoticed childhood. Her father died shortly after Bessie was born, and her mother died by the time she was eight or nine. Bessie was reared by her oldest sister Viola. As a consequence, Bessie was unable to gain an education. Around 1913 she toured in a show with Ma Rainey, one of the first great blues singers. Bessie's big break came in 1923, when she made her first recordings, including the classic Down Hearted Blues, which became an enormous success, selling more than two million copies. She recorded approximately 160 songs, accompanied by musicians who also made music history, including trumpet player Louis Armstrong. Bessie died in 1937 and is still remembered today as __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① the "Empress of the Blues": Bessie Smith의 상징적 별칭이자 오늘날까지 기억되는 칭호.
❌ ② a forgotten classical pianist: '클래식 피아니스트'는 블루스 가수와 전혀 다른 분야.
❌ ③ the inventor of jazz trumpet: '재즈 트럼펫 발명가'는 Louis Armstrong과 헷갈리게 하는 오답이며 사실도 아님.
❌ ④ a silent movie actress: '무성영화 배우'는 음악가 Bessie와 무관.
det.tip: Empress of the Blues = 블루스의 여제, Bessie Smith의 불후의 별칭.
